title: Senior Product Manager, Developer Platform
description:
Meridian Analytics is a Series C B2B SaaS company building data infrastructure tools for engineering teams. We're looking for a Senior PM to own our developer platform — the APIs, SDKs, and integrations used by 800+ enterprise customers.

What you'll do:
- Own the roadmap for our REST API and webhook infrastructure
- Work closely with engineering leads on technical architecture decisions
- Define developer experience improvements based on customer feedback and support data
- Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success on enterprise customer requirements
- Ship detailed technical specs and partner with design on developer-facing UX

What we're looking for:
- 6+ years of product management experience with at least 3 in developer tools, APIs, or platform products
- Strong technical background — you can read code, understand API design tradeoffs, and have written technical specs
- Experience at a B2B SaaS company with enterprise customers
- Proven track record of shipping developer-facing features with measurable adoption impact
- High comfort with data — you use SQL and analytics tools to drive decisions
- Remote-friendly, must be US-based

Bonus points:
- Experience with 0-to-1 product launches
- Background as a software engineer
- Experience with data infrastructure or analytics tooling

We offer competitive salary ($170k-$210k), equity, and full remote flexibility.
